git_workflow.branch_workflow: Each build task uses a short-lived branch/worktree from green main, pushes the branch and opens a PR against main with gh pr create.
git_workflow.merge_policy: No direct pushes to main, no force-push, no self-merge of unreviewed work; independent Reviewer and Test-Engineer verification required; Integrator-only merges in dependency order.
git_workflow.control_plane: Feature branches append their own LOG/handoff files; the Orchestrator serializes STATE.md and TASKS.json changes and resolves control-plane conflicts before Integrator merge.

attempt_policy: Maximum four attempts per task; at attempt four pass all gates or stop and escalate to the Orchestrator. No fifth attempt is authorized.

dependency_satisfaction.implemented: Implementation and author-run unit tests exist on the task branch; dependents may consume branch artifacts but may not merge.
dependency_satisfaction.independently_verified: A different reviewer session and tester session accepted the same commit with command logs; dependents may use the evidence.
dependency_satisfaction.merged: The Integrator accepted the branch evidence, merged the PR into green main and recorded the merge SHA; dependents branch from this merged main.
dependency_satisfaction.recorded: A control/readiness task archived its structured result; it makes no code-merge claim.

gate_policy: A task may be done only when every listed ARxx-Gn has a passing structured gate result. Missing, disabled, stale or inconclusive evidence exits nonzero and keeps the task partial/blocked/failed even when implementation is complete.
artifact_policy: Artifacts are immutable by SHA-256. Any repair creates a new artifact ID and invalidates downstream platform, callback, benchmark, IME, AT, license and docs evidence until P1-ARTIFACT-GATE01 reruns them.

review_model.identity_constraint: One GitHub identity is available; role separation is proved by distinct agent session IDs and signed/harness review records, not GitHub approval metadata.
review_model.evidence: evidence/<task-id>/branch-evidence.json records branch, commit, role/session IDs, command logs, review findings, test results and Integrator merge SHA.
review_model.enforcement: tools/ci/branch_gate.py exits nonzero unless all required roles and same-commit evidence exist; main is merged only by the Integrator.
